notes.title: Rhythm Sprout Soundtrack is now available on Spotify!
notes.content:
Hello onion bulbs,

We are happy to announce that Part 1 of the original soundtrack for Rhythm Sprout (34 songs) is now live on [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/3zUg9WzrJ3l7MerwUbwe2K?si=R1ebF0tFS1y0QUN8sHwfHg&nd=1]Spotify[/url]! It will be gradually available on other platforms such as Tidal, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Deezer, TikTok, Pandora, Amazon, Instagram and iHeartRadio in the upcoming days. Keep your eyes peeled for part 2 of the soundtrack, which will include the songs from cutscenes (22 songs), and will be released on all platforms at a later date.

You can now relive your favorite moments from the game on the go!

We spoke with [i]Rune[/i], the sole sound engineer from [url=https://twitter.com/surtgames]SURT Games[/url], who shared with us that the goal was to create a soundtrack that would match the game’s fast-paced gameplay, while still being enjoyable to listen to on its own.

The result is a soundtrack that perfectly captures the spirit of the game, with each track designed to elicit a specific emotion or feeling. From the pounding beat of the opening theme to the ambient tones of the game’s quieter moments, every track tells a story all on its own.

If you’re a fan of Rhythm Sprout or love great music in general, check out the original soundtrack on your preferred platform as soon as it is available. We highly recommend giving it a listen – you won’t be disappointed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201042/a969123f01f7165bd1b77409f871e80f7ece5afc.jpg[/img]

A friendly reminder that you can get [b]20% off[/b] the Rhythm Sprout soundtrack during the [b]Spring Sale[/b] (ending soon) or an unbeatable [b]32% off[/b] if you get the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30351/Rhythm_Sprout_Beats_Bundle/]Beats Bundle with the game[/url]. If you already own them, consider gifting them while the sale lasts!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Feb 22nd
notes.content:
This update focuses mostly on a small rebalancing of the Target Scores. The change is relatively minor, but should help a lot of you achieve the Target Scores with less frustration. You will still need to learn each level properly and be precise in your gameplay, but the new targets will allow for slightly more mistakes overall.

Let us know what you think of the change!

[b]NOTE:[/b] If you've already achieved the [i]updated Target Score[/i] for a level on a previous run, you will need to play through it again to get the Star.

[b]Specifics[/b]
- The second Target Score is adjusted by a set percentage for all levels
- The third Target Score is adjusted for all levels depending on the level's length [i](shorter levels get a very smaller change, and longer levels get a bigger change)[/i]
- Fixed typos and text going outside of textboxes in German, Norwegian and Russian

notes.title: Rhythm Sprout is Out Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, onion bulbs! 

The release day for Rhythm Sprout has arrived, and you can now save the Vegetable Kingdom with your rhythm skills and just a few bucks by taking advantage of the 10% launch discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1475840/

[b][h3]Watch the Launch Trailer[/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=QaSV1PrlBrI;full][/previewyoutube] 

Spice up your way through the Vegetable Kingdom and enjoy your quirky, fun rhythm adventure with the various Sprout skins that you can unlock throughout your journey! The game features 25 STORY levels and five specially-designed BONUS challenges.

[b][h3]Choose your playstyle[/h3][/b]
You will find your playstyle whether you are a beginner or a seasoned rhythm game player. Once you've finished a level in default or beginner difficulty, the EX modes for that level will be unlocked. Every level has EX modes that can be combined to change the difficulty or add variety to your gameplay experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201042/154e6a0f0cd5af39f23e3dd09d723593c56d60e5.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Dress for success[/h3][/b]
Unlock skins for Sprout and his sword! There are 20 outfits for Sprout and 12 skins for his sword! 
The Hello Neighbor skins (Mr. Peterson, Imbir, and shovel) are unlocked from the start of the game for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201042/ce89210b6839871c4448e1601ade4c586458927e.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Corsair iCUE integration for PC[/h3][/b]
Elevate your PC experience and increase your immersion with CORSAIR's iCUE technology. Synchronizing the RGB lighting on all your compatible CORSAIR devices gives you a setup-wide light show to go with your rhythm adventure. 

[previewyoutube=-n7PQmpB8rg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h3]Grab the beats on the go[/h3][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294270/RHYTHM_SPROUT_Soundtrack/
You wanted it, and you got it! You can now get the standalone Original Soundtrack on Steam or together with the game when buying the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30351/Rhythm_Sprout_Beats_Bundle/]Beats Bundle[/url]. All songs were produced by Rune from SURT Games. We're currently looking at getting it on Spotify and other music streaming platforms. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Rhythm Sprout just dropped a freshly new DEMO and trailer!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings lovely human beings![/h3]

Warm up your fingers to tap along to some fresh and funky beats!

Our rhythm action, Rhythm Sprout, invites you to join the musical adventure for the first time! 

[b]Play the new DEMO, Wishlist and subscribe to the Rhythm Sprout Newsletter. We will share more major updates and exclusive materials soon. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1475840/

[h3][url=http://eepurl.com/hZDoNv]👉Click To Subscribe To Newsletter Now! 👈[/url][/h3]

At the heart of Rhythm Sprout lies a quirky mix of funky electronic music and adorably silly stories. Amp up the pace (and BPM) as you chop, slice and julienne your way through a rogue’s gallery of sugary opponents!

[h3]Watch this fresh trailer to start vibing now![/h3]
[previewyoutube=Bc5zD76cFqk;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

In Rhythm Sprout, you wake up as a little onion named Sprout. As the chosen savior of the vegetable kingdom, you are destined to defend the invasion from [b]the evil King Sugar Daddy and his Army of Sugary Sweets![/b] Use your sense of rhythm to defeat formidable enemies, rescue Princess Cauliflower and survive some bad jokes from the strange but adorable inhabitants. 

[b]If you cannot wait to grab the latest news on the game, show your high scores to the community or talk to fellow players about tips and preferences, join us in our brand new social channels! We are thrilled to grow our communities with you![/b]

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/RhythmSprout]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/RhythmSprout/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/RhythmSprout/]Instagram[/url] 
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/b94YvPZyVC]Discord[/url]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[u][h2]Fun features in this demo:[/h2][/u]

[b][h3]- Check out 3 playable levels with a scale of difficulty options[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IDODVLs.gif[/img]

Your rhythmic journey is set in a world filled with different seasons, themes, props and enemies. Hop through the picturesque seasons with a simple three-button control scheme and work your way up to a more bizarre and intriguing setting. 

[b][h3]- Jam to the varied OST[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D9dk4D1.gif[/img]

With an expanded adventure comes a more diverse list of tracks that were inspired by a variety of styles, genres and time-periods. Chill with a laid-back lo-fi inspired slow jam in Winter Woods or sneak into the Haunted Mansion with some gloomy Latino beats, all music fans are welcome. 

[b][h3]- Unravel the story[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201042/3f9abca3c917069cd8f4f2685ed872269c1544d1.png[/img]

Find out more about the princess, your opponents and the kingdom in 3 story scenes in between battles!

[h3]- Stay tuned for more fun content to be shared in the near future![/h3]

[h3]Thank you for coming by lovely humans! We look forward to seeing you all in the beats![/h3]
